what_to_detect: A decision candidate that is an equip (Attach) ability offered at sorcery timing: its casting_speed check passes.
near_miss: An equip (Attach) ability offered outside a sorcery window, its casting_speed check failed.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate that is an equip ability with a quality restriction (Equip [quality]), and a creature its controller controls that lacks the quality, excluded from the candidate's legal targets.
near_miss: A creature with the quality, listed in the equip ability's legal_targets.
record_fields: playability/decision payload.candidates[].legal_targets (gen-3: union over every targeting clause, uncapped)
snapshot entities and players (the universe of possible targets)

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which an Equipment with a quality-restricted equip ability still contributes to the creature it is attached to although that creature no longer has the quality.
near_miss: The Equipment's contribution to an attached creature that has the equip quality.
record_fields: snapshot attached_to and the attached creature's types

what_to_detect: A decision listing two or more equip abilities of one source permanent as candidates, one of them playable while another is not.
near_miss: A decision where every equip ability of the source is unplayable.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate that is an equip planeswalker ability, and a planeswalker its controller controls listed in its legal targets.
near_miss: A creature that is not a planeswalker, excluded from the equip planeswalker ability's legal targets.
record_fields: playability/decision payload.candidates[].legal_targets (gen-3: union over every targeting clause, uncapped)
snapshot entities and players (the universe of possible targets)
